Consider replacing with a Bootstrap utility class (e.g., w-auto) for consistency, if supported by the HTMLTag API.

comments.note: No unit tests exist for Bootstrap5Renderer.renderPaginationRow() or Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector(). The existing test suite covers the pagination model layer (GridPaginationTest) but not renderer HTML output. A dedicated RendererPaginationTest (or extension of RendererSortHeaderTest) covering IPP rendering, nav-only rendering, and the totalPages<=1+IPP edge case would significantly improve confidence in future regressions.

Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() uses style='width:auto' as an inline style on the <select>. The rest of the Bootstrap 5 renderer relies exclusively on utility classes. Consider using w-auto Bootstrap utility class if supported by the HTMLTag API for consistency (pre-existing developer observation, not a blocker).

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria are satisfied and confirmed. Implementation is clean, secure (no XSS surface, json_encode escaping in JS handler), and follows project conventions.

Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() correctly overrides the base, calls parent::, decorates the <select> with Bootstrap utility classes (form-select form-select-sm), and wraps it in a d-flex container — consistent with the established decorator pattern used in createSortAnchor().

One non-blocking DRY issue: renderPaginationRow() in Bootstrap5Renderer is a full copy of the base-class method, differing only in the final call (createBootstrapPaginationRow vs createPaginationRow). The base class already uses the Template Method pattern — overriding createPaginationRow() instead would eliminate guard duplication. If guards change in the base class, Bootstrap5Renderer will silently drift.

The inline style='width:auto' on the <select> deviates from the utility-class approach, but the same deviation already exists in createPageJumpContainer() and is a project-wide pre-existing pattern. Not a blocker.
PHPStan level 6: 0 errors. PHPUnit: 112/112 pass.

comments.note: Bootstrap5Renderer.renderPaginationRow() duplicates the guard logic from BaseGridRenderer.renderPaginationRow() verbatim. The base class follows the Template Method pattern: renderPaginationRow() handles guards and delegates to the protected createPaginationRow(). Bootstrap5Renderer should override createPaginationRow() instead of renderPaginationRow() to eliminate the duplication. If future WPs add guards to the base method, this override will silently miss them.

Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() uses style='width:auto' as an inline style on the <select> element. This is a minor deviation from the all-utility-class approach used elsewhere, but consistent with the pre-existing style='width:80px' in createPageJumpContainer(). If/when the project-wide inline style pattern is addressed, both usages should be updated together (e.g., to w-auto and w-20 Bootstrap classes).

No renderer-level unit tests exist for Bootstrap5Renderer pagination output (noted by QA). A future RendererPaginationTest covering the five totalPages/IPP/provider edge-case combinations would improve regression confidence. Recommend creating as a follow-up WP.
